incidents.title: Owner portal entry — monitoring verification false alarm
incidents.detail: An obsolete HTML title expectation in the external owner-page monitor caused incorrect failed verification results. The portal's actual page title is 'Property Operations · 115 Schiller'. The corrected monitor has passed its first check; a second successful check is required to close this incident. The earlier failed validations do not establish that the portal was unavailable.

updates.detail: Two consecutive external page checks failed. The cause has not been established.

Cause identified: the monitor expected an outdated owner-page title. The assertion was corrected and deployed; the first verification passed. Monitoring recovery. Previously recorded failed checks are retained.

scope: External HTTP page reachability only; no checkout, availability, account authentication, or task workflows tested.
